# Result&lt;T, E&gt;

The outcome of an operation that can fail, kept as a value: what it produced, or the error it threw.

```rux
pub variant Result<T, E> {
    Success(T),
    Failure(E)
}
```

Owns its payload, so a `Result` is move-only exactly when its success or error type is.

## Type parameters

| Name | Description          |
| ---- | -------------------- |
| `T`  | what a success holds |
| `E`  | what a failure holds |

## Cases

| Name         | Description                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `Success(T)` | The operation succeeded and produced this value. |
| `Failure(E)` | The operation failed with this error.            |
